name: The Prodigal Lich
summary: In the Undercity, Bethor Iceshard needs an agent for a mission involving a wayward lich. After your work in Brill against Scourge remnants and Rot Hide gnolls, Magistrate Sevren sends you south with orders.

sections.title: Summons to the Capital
sections.body: Magistrate Sevren judges you worthy of greater Forsaken work after your service in Brill. He sends you to Bethor Iceshard, a formidable mage in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, who wants an agent tested against the Scourge. Sevren gives you official orders to carry beneath the ruins of Lordaeron, into the corridors of the Forsaken capital.

sections.title: A Wayward Lich
sections.body: Magistrate Sevren does not know the exact details, but the orders concern finding and recruiting a rogue lich. Liches are among the Scourge's deadliest spellcasters, and dealing with one is perilous. You bring the orders to Bethor atop his arcane sanctum. The icy mage gets straight to business, ready to see whether Brill's magistrate has sent someone strong enough to track such dangerous quarry.

faq.q: Who sends me on this task?
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren, the Forsaken official who administers Brill in Tirisfal Glades, sends you to Bethor Iceshard with written orders.

faq.q: Where do I find Bethor Iceshard?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard resides in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, atop the central elevated structure surrounded by arcane energies.

faq.q: What is the mission mentioned in the orders?
faq.answer: Bethor intends to enlist a wandering, rogue lich. First, he needs an agent able to follow clues to the lich's identity and whereabouts.

faq.q: Why does Bethor require an agent tested against the Scourge?
faq.answer: Liches master necromantic frost and death magic, and were originally bound to the Lich King. Facing a free-willed or isolated lich calls for someone who has proved able to survive Scourge undead.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before receiving this quest?
faq.answer: Before receiving these orders, you must complete Magistrate Sevren's earlier assignment, 'Graverobbers', clearing Rot Hide gnolls and grave thieves from Garren's Haunt.

faq.q: What comes after reporting to Bethor?
aliases: what is next after prodigal lich
faq.answer: After you deliver Sevren's orders, Bethor offers 'The Lich's Identity'. He sends you to investigate artifacts and clues that may reveal who the mysterious being was in life.

angles.text: As an Undead, your first direct orders from the capital take you from local militia work in Brill to carrying out the Undercity's wider aims.
As a Mage, you report to Bethor Iceshard, one of the Forsaken's most powerful arcane and frost masters.
As a member of the Horde, securing unaligned or powerful necromantic assets strengthens the Forsaken's precarious hold on Lordaeron's ruins against common enemies.
